questions.stem: 越多消費者習慣用手機付款，由機器經營的商店就會越普遍。
questions.answer: The more consumers get used to paying by phone, the more common stores run by machines will become.
accepted_answers: The more consumers become used to paying with their phones, the more common stores operated by machines will be.
The more customers are used to paying with their phones, the more common stores run by machines will become.

questions.stem: 和在櫃檯排隊結帳相比，離開前掃描手機付款方便多了。
questions.answer: Compared with lining up to pay at the counter, scanning your phone before leaving is much more convenient.
accepted_answers: Compared to waiting in line at the counter, paying by scanning your phone before leaving is far more convenient.
Compared with standing in line at the counter, scanning your phone to pay before leaving is a lot more convenient.

1.explanation_zh: 「越…，就越…」用 The + 比較級 + S + V, the + 比較級 + S + V：The more consumers get used to …, the more common … will become，第二個子句的形容詞 common 要跟著 the more 移到最前面。「習慣做…」是 get／be used to + V-ing（to 是介系詞）。「由機器經營的商店」中文把修飾語放前面，英文用過去分詞片語後位修飾：stores run (operated) by machines，商店是被經營，所以用過去分詞 run。
evidence: 越多消費者習慣用手機付款
1.strategy_zh: 「越…越…」先把兩個比較級各放到子句開頭；「被…的＋名詞」想「名詞＋過去分詞片語」。
hints: 切成四段：越多消費者／習慣用手機付款／由機器經營的商店／就會越普遍
標的詞彙：consumer（消費者）、pay（付款）、phone（手機）、machine（機器）、run（經營，也可用 operate）、common（普遍的）
句型框架：The more + S + V …, the more + adj. + N + p.p. … + will become

2.explanation_zh: 「和…相比」用 Compared with／to + 名詞或動名詞放句首：Compared with lining up to pay at the counter（with 是介系詞，後面用 V-ing）。後半句的主詞是「離開前掃描手機付款」這個動作，用動名詞 scanning your phone；「離開前」可以寫成連接詞＋分詞 before leaving。「方便多了」是比較級，用 much／far／a lot + more convenient。
evidence: 和在櫃檯排隊結帳相比
2.strategy_zh: 「和…相比」想 Compared with；before／after／when 後面省略主詞時接 V-ing；「…多了」用 much + 比較級。
hints: 切成四段：和在櫃檯排隊結帳相比／離開前／掃描手機付款／方便多了
標的詞彙：counter（櫃檯）、line（排隊；line up／wait in line）、scan（掃描）、phone（手機）、leave（離開）、convenient（方便的）
句型框架：Compared with + V-ing …, V-ing … before + V-ing + is much more + adj.

1.translation: The more consumers get used to paying with their phones, the more common stores run by machines will become.
1.explanation_zh: 「越…就越…」用 the 比較級…, the 比較級…；「習慣用手機付款」用 get used to + V-ing；「由機器經營的商店」用過去分詞片語 run by machines 後置修飾。

2.translation: Compared with lining up at the counter to check out, scanning your phone to pay before you leave is much more convenient.
2.explanation_zh: 「和…相比」用 Compared with + V-ing；「掃描手機付款」是動作當主詞，用動名詞 scanning；「方便多了」用 much more convenient；中文泛指，用 your/you。

issues_zh: 標的句型 PART（連接詞＋分詞 before leaving）沒有被中文自然引出：「離開前」直接譯成 before you leave 一樣自然，我的盲譯就是這樣寫，而且第 2 部分 accepted 本身也收了 before you leave，等於句型目標和可接受寫法互相矛盾。
建議把這一句的第二個句型換成中文確實會逼出來的「動名詞當主詞」（scanning your phone to pay … is much more convenient，restructuring_zh 也是這樣說明），或刪掉 accepted 的 before you leave 並改寫中文讓 before + V-ing 成為唯一自然的寫法。

1.explanation_zh: 「越……就越……」用 the more ..., the more ...；「習慣」用 get used to + V-ing；「由機器經營的商店」用過去分詞後置修飾 stores run by machines。

2.translation: Compared with standing in line at the checkout counter, scanning your phone to pay before you leave is much more convenient.
2.explanation_zh: 「和……相比」用 compared with + V-ing；「方便多了」用 much more convenient（much 修飾比較級）；動名詞 scanning 當主詞。

issues_zh: 標的句型 PART（gp-conj-participle：before + V-ing）沒有被中文自然引出：「離開前」我自然譯成 before you leave（子句），沒有用 before leaving；第 2 部分 accepted 也收 before you leave，與標的句型 PART 互相矛盾（收進來的寫法並沒有用到該句型）。建議刪掉 accepted 裡的子句寫法、並讓中文更強制分詞構句（例如省略主詞的情境），或把 PART 從這一句的標的句型拿掉。
